input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for redis config, order application, order. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Candidate, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a User, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
